name: Camp Agawam
description_short: A day camp at the Agawam Hunt club for grades 1–6, running 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. Each day campers spend an hour each at the racquets courts (tennis, squash, pickleball), the golf course, the pool and the lawn, and lunch is included.
swim_waterfront_notes: The club has a pool, and campers get pool time and pool games each day. The page does not mention swim instruction, swim tests or lifeguards.

source.title: Golf and Tennis Summer Camp in Rumford and Providence, RI | Agawam Hunt

warnings: The page only lists the Summer 2026 season, which is already over (today is 2026-10-13). Dates and prices for 2027 are not posted yet.

Prices differ for members and non-members. price_per_week is the 5-day non-member rate ($465); members pay $415. A 3-day option costs $290 for members and $320 for non-members. Session prices are left blank because each week has more than one rate.

The page also describes other Agawam programs for grades 5–10 (Racquets Academy, Racquets & Golf Sports Academy, Junior Golf Development Camp), but gives no dates or prices for them. This listing covers Camp Agawam only.
The camp can cancel full or partial days with one day's notice if rain would keep campers inside most of the day.
Registration runs through Lincoln School's form, not Agawam's own system.
